# Local Boost Networking

> Local Boost Networking is a lead generation agency for home service businesses across the United States. We run Google Ads, Meta campaigns, local SEO, websites, CRM, and pay-per-call routing. Our average client receives 127 qualified inbound calls a month at a $32 cost per call, with a 68% booking rate and $37,700 average monthly revenue.

## What we do

We handle the full lead generation stack for home service contractors. Clients answer the phone. We do everything else.

- **Google Ads and Local SEO**: Google Business Profile optimization, citation building, and search rankings tuned for home service contractors.
- **Paid Ad Campaigns**: Google Search and Meta campaigns aimed at people ready to book. Weekly creative testing and budget optimization.
- **Pay-Per-Call System**: Inbound call generation routed through Ringba with full tracking. Clients pay only when a real buyer calls.
- **CRM and Lead Automation**: Custom GoHighLevel CRM that tracks every lead and automates follow-ups.
- **Client Dashboard**: Live reporting on calls, leads, pipeline status, and revenue.
- **Website Design and Build**: Fast, conversion-focused websites built around the client's trade and service area.

## Industries served

Roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, pool service, solar, water systems, insulation, locksmiths, painting, remodeling, handyman, general contracting.

## Performance benchmarks (averages across active clients)

- Average inbound calls per month per client: 127
- Cost per qualified call: $32
- Booking rate from inbound calls: 68%
- Average monthly revenue per client: $37,700
- Time to first results: 1 to 2 weeks
- Time to full revenue benchmark: ~60 days

## Verified case studies

Real ad-account screenshots are available on the homepage.

- Roofing client (2 months on Google Ads): $1,267.60 ad spend, $20,412 revenue, 16.11 ROAS, 14.29% close rate.
- Pool company (2 years on Meta): $38,609.46 ad spend, $790,800 revenue, 20.49 ROAS, 1,358 opportunities generated.
- Insulation and rodent company (2 years on Meta): $71,895.43 ad spend, $559,453 revenue, 7.78 ROAS, 1,317 opportunities generated.
- Water systems company (4 months on Google Ads): $6,673.80 ad spend, $23,331.52 revenue, 3.50 ROAS.
- Solar company (5 months on Meta): $4,969.22 ad spend, $30,000 revenue, 6.04 ROAS, 13 deals closed.
